subject: Scheduling: technical deep-dive — rotating windows proposal
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Gomez <natalie@acmeanalytics.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up & proposed next step: technical deep-dive

Hi Natalie / Tom —

Great speaking with you today. Quick recap from our discovery: Acme is evaluating hosted inference for low-latency customer-facing features, primary goals are predictable p99 latency, lower per-token costs, and data isolation for regulated datasets. Key constraints you mentioned: SOC2+ evidence, VPC peering for Private mode, and ability to run canary rollouts across models.

Next step: we recommended a technical deep-dive with our solutions engineer to go over architecture, SLA implications, and a short demo of the workload profile. Because your team spans NA + EMEA + APAC, I want to propose a rotating set of weekly windows so we share the burden of inconvenient times across teams rather than always asking the same people to join late or early.

Suggested approach (high level):
- 3-week rotation of primary demo windows: Week A = Americas-friendly, Week B = Europe-friendly, Week C = APAC-friendly.
- Each week we offer one daytime slot for that region and one mid-overlap slot for global attendees.
- We'll keep the same recurring meeting (90 minutes) and update the meeting invite with the active window each week; provides consistency for calendars.

Concrete slot options for the first two rotation weeks (UTC offsets shown):
- Week A (Americas week) — Tue Mar 23, 2026 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET (19:00 UTC)
- Week B (Europe week)   — Thu Mar 25, 2026 16:00 CET (15:00 UTC)
- Week C (APAC week)     — Wed Mar 31, 2026 10:00 SGT / 09:00 ICT (02:00 UTC) — we understand this is early for NA, hence rotation

Can you reply with: (1) which of the three initial slots you prefer for the formal deep-dive, and (2) do you agree to the 3-week rotation idea? If none of those match, please share a couple of times that work next week and we’ll propose alternatives.

I attached my notes from today's discovery (discovery-notes.pdf) and a short proposed agenda (demo-agenda.pdf).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0172

Proposed rotation mechanics (detailed):
- Recurring 90-minute deep-dive meeting created as a single event. Each week we set the "active window" according to the 3-week rotation (Week A/B/C). Calendar invite will include the regional time in the event title and REMINDER text each week.
- Week pattern:
  * Week A (Americas): 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET (best for NA attendees)
  * Week B (Europe): 16:00 CET / 15:00 UTC (best for EMEA attendees)
  * Week C (APAC): 10:00 SGT / 09:00 ICT (best for APAC attendees)
- Rotation examples: Mar 23 = Americas, Mar 25 = Europe, Mar 31 = APAC. We’ll keep the same recurring meeting and change the event timezone display for the active week so calendar sync works for everyone.

Logan (cc) will lead the demo/architecture portion and Dylan is looped for any contract/SLAs questions that come up.

Natalie — can you confirm the attendee list (you mentioned Tom + Chris + yourself) and whether you want us to share any environment prep (sample dataset, ingestion keys) ahead of time? If you confirm, I’ll send the invite and attach the agenda + SLA excerpt.

Thanks,
Aisha
